description: Comprehensive banking threat detection rules. Covers overlay attacks (classic + modern), 2FA/OTP interception (SMS, notification, accessibility, push), credential theft (keylogging, form injection, screen capture), automated transfer systems (ATS), call interception/forwarding, payment hijacking, crypto theft, banking app targeting, session hijacking, card data theft, anti-fraud bypass, and social engineering. Based on real-world banking malware families: Anubis, Cerberus, Hydra, Flubot, SharkBot, Vultur, Hook, Godfather, Xenomorph, Octo, Ermac, Coper, TeaBot, BianLian, Medusa, ToxicPanda, SpyNote.

rules.name: Classic Banking Overlay Attack (Anubis/Cerberus pattern)
rules.description: Accessibility + SYSTEM_ALERT_WINDOW + internet + performGlobalAction — the original banking trojan technique. Draws a fake login screen pixel-identical to the real banking app over the legitimate app, captures entered credentials, then sends them to C2 server while forwarding user to the real app.

rules.name: Modern A11y-Only Overlay (Hook/Ermac pattern)
rules.description: Uses AccessibilityService alone for overlay injection without SYSTEM_ALERT_WINDOW. Injects fake UI elements directly into the accessibility tree or uses TYPE_APPLICATION_OVERLAY. Bypasses Play Protect overlay detection. Used by Hook, Ermac, and Xenomorph v3+.

rules.name: WebView Injection Overlay (Godfather pattern)
rules.description: Loads phishing HTML/JS pages in WebView overlay on top of banking app. JavaScript captures keystrokes from fake form and sends to C2. More flexible than static overlays — can be updated from server without app update.

rules.name: WebView JavaScript Bridge Credential Capture
rules.description: WebView with JavaScript bridge + evaluateJavascript — injects JS to capture form data from overlay phishing page and passes credentials to Java code via @JavascriptInterface.

rules.name: Dynamic HTML Overlay Injection (Server-side)
rules.description: Downloads overlay HTML from C2 server at runtime, targeting specific banking apps detected on device. Allows attacker to add new bank targets without updating the malware APK.

rules.name: Usage Stats Overlay Trigger (TeaBot pattern)
rules.description: Uses PACKAGE_USAGE_STATS to detect when banking app is opened, then instantly injects overlay. More reliable than accessibility-based foreground app detection. Used by TeaBot, BianLian.

rules.name: Overlay + Notification Dismiss (Anti-detection)
rules.description: Injects overlay AND dismisses banking app's security notifications to prevent user from noticing the attack. Combines overlay injection with notification listener abuse.

rules.name: Custom Chrome Tab Phishing Overlay
rules.description: Uses Custom Chrome Tabs to display phishing login page that appears as legitimate browser session with correct URL bar theming. Harder for user to distinguish from real site.

rules.name: SMS 2FA Code Interception
rules.description: Intercepts incoming SMS in real-time to steal banking OTP/2FA codes before user sees them. Can abort broadcast to hide the SMS notification. Primary 2FA bypass technique for banking trojans.

rules.name: SMS Receiver with Internet (2FA Relay)
rules.description: SMS broadcast receiver + internet permission — intercepts SMS and forwards to C2 server. Core component of every SMS-based 2FA stealing trojan.

rules.name: SMS Auto-Forward to Attacker
rules.description: Intercepts SMS and auto-forwards via SmsManager.sendTextMessage to attacker's phone number. Simple but effective 2FA relay — no internet C2 needed.

rules.name: Default SMS App Hijack for 2FA
rules.description: Attempts to become default SMS app to intercept ALL messages silently, including banking OTPs. Registers as SMS_DELIVER + WAP_PUSH_DELIVER handler.

rules.name: Notification 2FA/Push Auth Interception
rules.description: NotificationListenerService captures banking push notifications including OTP codes, transaction confirmations, and push authentication prompts. Can auto-approve push 2FA via accessibility.

rules.name: Push 2FA Auto-Approve (A11y + Notification)
rules.description: Combines notification listener + accessibility to automatically approve push-based 2FA prompts. Reads the notification, opens it, and clicks 'Approve' button via accessibility — completely automated 2FA bypass.

rules.name: TOTP Code Reader via Accessibility
rules.description: Uses AccessibilityService to read TOTP codes displayed by authenticator apps (Google Authenticator, Authy, etc.). Traverses UI tree to find and extract the 6-digit code.

rules.name: Complete 2FA Bypass Chain (All Vectors)
rules.description: SMS + Notification + Accessibility — bypasses ALL common 2FA methods simultaneously: SMS OTP, push notification, TOTP display, and biometric prompt. No 2FA method is safe against this combination.

rules.name: Accessibility Keylogger (Credential Capture)
rules.description: Captures all text input events via AccessibilityService TYPE_VIEW_TEXT_CHANGED. Logs every keystroke including banking credentials, PINs, passwords, and card numbers. Core credential theft technique in modern banking trojans.

rules.name: Form Injection via Accessibility (getText/setText)
rules.description: Uses AccessibilityService to read text from banking app fields (getText) and inject text (setText). Can steal entered credentials AND auto-fill attacker's account details for unauthorized transfers.

rules.name: Screen Recording for Credential Capture (Vultur pattern)
rules.description: Records device screen via MediaProjection to capture banking credentials as user types them. Streams screen to attacker's server in real-time. Used by Vultur and Octo banking trojans as alternative to overlay attacks.

rules.name: VNC/Screen Streaming for Manual Fraud
rules.description: Streams victim's screen to attacker in real-time for manual on-device fraud. Attacker watches victim use banking app and takes control at critical moment. Combines screen capture with remote input injection.

rules.name: Screenshot Capture of Banking Screens
rules.description: Takes screenshots when banking apps are in foreground. Captures account balances, transaction details, and potentially entered credentials. Simpler than continuous screen recording.

rules.name: Clipboard Credential/Token Theft
rules.description: Monitors clipboard for copied banking credentials, account numbers, IBAN, tokens, and crypto addresses. Many users copy-paste credentials from password managers — this intercepts them.

rules.name: Fake Input Method for Credential Capture
rules.description: Registers as custom keyboard/input method to capture all keystrokes across all apps. More persistent than accessibility-based keylogging — works even when accessibility is disabled.

rules.name: Automated Transfer System — Basic ATS (SharkBot pattern)
rules.description: Uses accessibility to auto-fill recipient account and amount, then clicks transfer button. Performs unauthorized money transfer through victim's own banking app while device is idle. The most dangerous banking trojan technique — no overlay needed.

rules.name: ATS via Gesture Injection (Android 7+ API)
rules.description: Uses dispatchGesture API (Android 7+) for precise tap/swipe injection. Can navigate complex banking app UIs, scroll through menus, and complete multi-step transfers automatically.

rules.name: Complete ATS Chain (Detection + Injection + Confirmation)
rules.description: Full automated transfer: 1) Detects banking app via usage stats, 2) Injects recipient/amount via accessibility, 3) Bypasses 2FA via notification/SMS interception, 4) Confirms transfer. End-to-end automated fraud.

rules.name: Sleep-time ATS (Night-time Automated Fraud)
rules.description: Waits for device idle/screen-off state then performs automated transfers while victim sleeps. Uses AlarmManager for timing and reduces screen brightness to avoid detection.

rules.name: Banking Call Redirection/Forwarding
rules.description: Intercepts outgoing calls to bank and redirects to attacker's number. Victim thinks they're talking to bank support but actually talking to attacker who performs social engineering. Used by FakeCalls trojan family.

rules.name: USSD Call Forwarding Activation
rules.description: Activates call forwarding via USSD codes (*21*, *67*, *61*) to redirect all incoming calls (including bank verification calls) to attacker's number. Victim doesn't receive bank's security callbacks.

rules.name: Full Call Interception (Log + Redirect + Record)
rules.description: Complete call interception: reads call log, redirects outgoing calls, records call audio. Can intercept bank verification calls and record conversations with bank for later social engineering.

rules.name: Fake IVR/Bank Phone System
rules.description: Displays fake incoming call screen mimicking bank's caller ID, then plays recorded IVR prompts to trick victim into entering PIN/OTP via keypad. Social engineering via fake phone call.

rules.name: Google Play Billing Hijack
rules.description: Intercepts Google Play Billing flow to redirect payments or steal purchase tokens. Hooks into BillingClient responses to modify purchase verification.

rules.name: NFC Payment Relay Attack
rules.description: Captures NFC payment card data and relays to attacker's device for contactless payment fraud. Intercepts Host Card Emulation (HCE) APDU commands.

rules.name: QR Code Payment Hijack
rules.description: Intercepts QR code scanning in banking/payment apps via accessibility and replaces the QR payment data (account/address) with attacker's details.

rules.name: Payment Intent Hijack
rules.description: Intercepts payment-related intents (ACTION_SEND for payment apps, deep links to banking apps) and redirects to phishing activity that captures payment details.

rules.name: Banking App Target List — Package Enumeration
rules.description: Enumerates installed packages looking for banking/fintech apps. Builds target list to determine which overlay HTML to download from C2 server. Core reconnaissance step of every banking trojan.

rules.name: Foreground Banking App Detection via A11y
rules.description: Uses accessibility TYPE_WINDOW_STATE_CHANGED events to detect when user opens banking app, then triggers overlay injection. Real-time detection mechanism.

rules.name: Banking App Detection via Usage Stats
rules.description: Polls UsageStatsManager to detect foreground banking app without accessibility. Works as backup targeting mechanism when accessibility is not granted.

rules.name: Banking App Probe via Intent Resolution
rules.description: Uses resolveActivity/queryIntentActivities to check if specific banking apps are installed without QUERY_ALL_PACKAGES. Stealthier than getInstalledPackages.

rules.name: Card Data Overlay — Fake Card Entry Form
rules.description: Displays overlay with fake credit/debit card entry form requesting card number, expiry, CVV, and cardholder name. Captures and exfiltrates full card details.

rules.name: Card Data Scraping via Accessibility
rules.description: Reads credit card numbers and other financial data directly from banking app UI using accessibility node traversal. No overlay needed — steals data from legitimate app screens.

rules.name: Contactless Card Data Theft via NFC
rules.description: Reads contactless payment card data (PAN, expiry) via NFC IsoDep interface when card is tapped against device. Used by NGate malware to clone card data.

rules.name: Crypto Address Clipper (Clipboard Hijack)
rules.description: Monitors clipboard for cryptocurrency wallet addresses (BTC, ETH, etc.) and replaces them with attacker's address. Victim unknowingly sends crypto to attacker. Regex-based detection of wallet address patterns.

rules.name: Crypto Wallet Seed/Key Theft
rules.description: Searches device storage for cryptocurrency wallet files, seed phrase backups, private keys, and keystore files. Targets MetaMask, Trust Wallet, Coinbase Wallet data directories.

rules.name: Crypto Exchange Overlay Attack
rules.description: Targets crypto exchange apps (Binance, Coinbase, Kraken) with overlay phishing pages. Steals exchange login credentials and 2FA codes for account takeover.

rules.name: Crypto Transaction Hijack via Accessibility
rules.description: Uses accessibility to modify recipient address in crypto wallet/exchange app just before user confirms transaction. Changes destination wallet address to attacker's address at the last moment.

rules.name: Banking Session/Cookie Theft via WebView
rules.description: Extracts session cookies from banking WebView to hijack authenticated session. Uses CookieManager to read cookies and exfiltrate to C2 for session replay attack.

rules.name: OAuth/Bearer Token Extraction
rules.description: Extracts OAuth tokens or bearer tokens from app storage or memory. Can access banking API directly with stolen token without needing credentials.

rules.name: WebView JavaScript Injection for Session Theft
rules.description: Injects JavaScript into banking WebView to steal session data, form contents, and manipulate page DOM. Uses evaluateJavascript to execute attacker's code in banking page context.

rules.name: Google Play Protect Disable (via Accessibility)
rules.description: Uses accessibility to navigate to Play Protect settings and disable real-time scanning. Prevents Play Protect from detecting the banking trojan. First action many banking trojans perform after getting accessibility.

rules.name: Self-Grant Accessibility via Settings Navigation
rules.description: Automatically navigates to accessibility settings and enables its own accessibility service without user awareness. Opens Settings → Accessibility → finds own entry → enables toggle.

rules.name: Anti-Removal via Accessibility
rules.description: Prevents user from uninstalling the malware by intercepting Settings → Apps → Uninstall via accessibility. Presses 'Back' or 'Home' when uninstall screen is detected.

rules.name: Antivirus/Security App Disable
rules.description: Uses accessibility to disable or uninstall security apps (antivirus, banking security modules). Identifies security app packages and force-stops or uninstalls them.

rules.name: Device Admin Anti-Removal
rules.description: Registers as device administrator to prevent uninstallation. Combined with accessibility to automatically re-activate if user tries to revoke admin rights.

rules.name: Hidden App Icon (Stealth Mode)
rules.description: Removes app icon from launcher after installation to hide from victim. App continues running in background. Common first step for banking trojans after initial setup.

rules.name: Emulator/Sandbox Detection (Banking Context)
rules.description: Checks for emulator indicators before activating banking trojan functionality. Avoids execution in analysis sandboxes. Checks Build properties, IMEI, telephony state, sensors.

rules.name: Geo-fencing — Regional Banking Trojan Activation
rules.description: Checks SIM country code or locale to activate only in target countries. For example, activates overlay for Russian banks only in RU, or for EU banks only in EU countries. Reduces detection by avoiding activation in security researchers' countries.

rules.name: Fake Banking App Update Prompt
rules.description: Displays overlay claiming banking app needs urgent security update. Directs victim to download malicious APK disguised as update, or tricks into granting additional permissions.

rules.name: Fake Security Alert / Suspicious Activity Warning
rules.description: Shows fake 'suspicious activity detected' notification mimicking bank's branding. Urges victim to 'verify' their identity by entering credentials in phishing overlay.

rules.name: Push Notification Phishing
rules.description: Sends fake push notifications that look like they're from banking app. Notification leads to overlay phishing form when tapped. Uses Firebase/FCM for C2 to trigger phishing at scale.

rules.name: Banking C2 via Firebase Cloud Messaging
rules.description: Uses Firebase/FCM as C2 channel to receive commands (inject overlays, start screen recording, enable ATS) and report stolen data. Hides C2 traffic in legitimate Google infrastructure.

rules.name: Real-time Banking C2 via WebSocket
rules.description: WebSocket for real-time bidirectional C2 — essential for VNC-style screen streaming, real-time ATS, and interactive fraud sessions where attacker manually controls victim's banking app.

rules.name: JSON Command Handler (C2 Protocol)
rules.description: Parses JSON commands from C2 server with command dispatcher pattern. Supports commands like 'inject', 'sms_intercept', 'screen_record', 'ats_transfer'. Core C2 handler architecture.

rules.name: Device Fingerprint Spoofing (Anti-Fraud Bypass)
rules.description: Spoofs device identifiers (ANDROID_ID, Build properties, IMEI) to appear as victim's known trusted device. Bypasses banking app's device binding and fraud detection systems.

rules.name: Anti-Fraud System Proxy/VPN Detection
rules.description: Detects if banking app is checking for proxy/VPN to identify suspicious connections. Banking trojans check this to disable VPN before performing ATS to avoid triggering fraud detection.

rules.name: Accessibility Detection Bypass in Banking Apps
rules.description: Intercepts banking app's accessibility service detection check and returns false. Prevents banking app from blocking transactions when malicious accessibility service is active.

rules.name: Cerberus/Alien Family Full Pattern
rules.description: Complete Cerberus/Alien pattern: overlay + a11y + SMS + notification + boot + hidden icon + C2. Full-featured banking trojan with all attack vectors.

rules.name: Vultur/Octo Screen Streaming Pattern
rules.description: Screen recording + accessibility + internet — modern banking trojan that records screen instead of using overlays. Harder to detect because no fake UI is injected.

rules.name: SharkBot/Gustuff ATS Pattern
rules.description: Automated Transfer System: a11y-based auto-fill + auto-click + package awareness + SMS/notification interception for 2FA bypass. Complete automated fraud without victim interaction.

rules.name: Godfather Banking Trojan Pattern
rules.description: WebView-based dynamic overlay injection + accessibility + notification listener + multi-region targeting. Godfather's signature: downloads overlay HTML from C2, supports 400+ banking app targets across multiple countries.

rules.name: Hook Banking Trojan Remote Control Pattern
rules.description: Hook's signature: VNC-like remote control + WebSocket C2 + accessibility gesture injection + file manager. Attacker manually controls victim's banking app in real-time for on-device fraud.

rules.name: Xenomorph v3 Full-Featured Pattern
rules.description: Xenomorph v3's complete feature set: ATS engine + overlay framework + cookie stealer + crypto targeting + anti-detection. One of the most advanced banking trojans.

rules.name: FakeCalls Vishing Pattern
rules.description: Fake call overlay + call interception + audio playback — displays fake incoming call screen mimicking bank, intercepts outgoing calls to bank, plays pre-recorded IVR audio. Complete voice phishing infrastructure.

rules.name: NGate NFC Relay/Clone Pattern
rules.description: Reads NFC payment card data + relays to attacker device + overlay phishing for PIN. Complete contactless card cloning and fraud infrastructure.
